unpublished.unit: About 8,000 registered nurses at NYC Health + Hospitals and mayoral agencies
unpublished.missing: The contract that replaced the 2019-2023 agreement. It was settled in July 2023 after mediation and impasse arbitration and runs about five and a half years from March 2023. Neither the Office of Labor Relations nor NYC Health + Hospitals has posted its text.
unpublished.have_note: This database has only the 2019-2023 agreement, which is no longer the current contract.

evidence.quote: The five-and-a-half-year contract comes after a month of expedited mediation and then impasse arbitration.

unpublished.unit: About 8,500 firefighters plus fire marshals, wipers and marine pilots and engineers
unpublished.missing: The UFA's successor unit agreements. The 2022-2027 uniformed coalition agreement sets raises for the UFA and says its terms are to be written into successor unit agreements for three UFA units. The Office of Labor Relations has published unit agreements for 9 of the 11 coalition unions, but not the UFA's.
unpublished.have_note: This database has the UFA's 2017-2020 agreement, which the coalition deal continues except where it changes the terms, and the coalition agreement itself.

evidence.quote: July 31, 2020 (UFA-Firefighters/Fire Marshals); July 27, 2021 (UFA-Pilots/Marine Engineers) and July 31, 2020 (UFA-Wipers)
